title: Project registry (projects.yml)
description: Checked in pre-commit and CI. Rules that span several projects (unique names, subdomains and deploy keys) or several fields (health inside paths) are checked by the playbook (roles/projects/tasks/validate.yml); Terraform checks subdomains too.

name.description: Directories, registry entry and, with a database, the database and user (with - turned into _).

subdomain.description: DNS record (Terraform) and Caddy site. "@" is the root domain, and also gets www redirected to it.

title.description: Shown on the placeholder page. Defaults to name.

repo.description: Linked from the placeholder page. Optional: leave it out for private repositories.

database.description: A PostgreSQL database and user for the backend. Never turned back off automatically.

deploy_key.description: Public ed25519 key of the project's CI. Its authorized_keys line is fixed to deploying this project only. Without it, the project cannot be deployed.

allOf.description: At least one component: a site or a backend.
Only static sites can be deployed for now: a deploy key needs a site.
Only a backend can use a database.
With a site, the backend only gets the paths listed.
Without a site, the backend gets every path.

image.description: Image repository without a tag or digest: deploy.sh records the digest on the server.

health.description: Health check path, with the prefix: Caddy does not strip it.

paths.description: Caddy path matchers sent to the backend, such as /api/*.
